titleTr: Belli olmayan planlar: might, may, could

explainTr: 'Might', 'may' ve 'could' kesin olmayan şeyleri anlatır: bu bir olasılık, ama emin değilsin. 'Might' ve 'could' günlük konuşmada çok yaygındır; 'may' biraz daha resmidir.

Bu üç yardımcı fiil de tüm öznelerle aynıdır (he might, she may), -s almaz ve ardından yalın fiil gelir: She might call. Olumsuz: might not / may not. 'Could not' ile 'might not' farklı anlam taşır; şimdilik olasılık için might not / may not kullan.
Soru kurmak için genelde 'Do you think...?' veya 'Is it possible that...?' kullanırız. 'Maybe' ve 'perhaps' de aynı fikri verir: Maybe it will rain = It might rain.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede olasılık ek ile söylenir: 'yağmur yağabilir', 'gelebilirim', 'gelmeyebilirim'. İngilizcede ayrı bir kelime kullanırsın ve fiil yalın kalır: It might rain. I might not come. 'Might comes' veya 'might to come' demezsin.
table: özne + might not / may not + fiil

examples.en: I might go to the lake on Sunday.
She may not be at work today.
We might have a test, but I am not sure.

reading.title: Plans for the weekend
reading.text:
It is Wednesday, and Hafsa's plans for the weekend are still uncertain. She might go to a school fair on Saturday, or she might stay home and study. It depends on the weather and on her work schedule.

The district may call her this week. If a teacher is sick, the office could ask her to work as a substitute on Friday. Hafsa has not decided what to do if that happens. "I might say yes," she tells Linda, "but I'm not sure my English is good enough for a whole day." Linda laughs. "You could ask Mr. Brown for the sub plan first. Perhaps he can explain everything."

Emre has plans too. He may go to a basketball game with his friends on Saturday evening, but the tickets might be sold out. If that happens, he could stay home and cook dinner with his mom. He has not confirmed anything yet.

Linda has the most uncertain plan of all. She is thinking about driving to the lake on Sunday. "The forecast says it might rain, so I could postpone the trip until next week. There is a small chance of sun in the afternoon." She may also invite Hafsa, if there is room in the car.

"We shouldn't make any promises yet," Hafsa says. "Let's decide on Friday evening. By then, we will know the weather and my schedule." Linda agrees. "Good idea. Plans can change, and we have more than one option."

questions.q: What might Hafsa do on Saturday?
options: Go to a school fair or stay home and study
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'She might go to a school fair on Saturday, or she might stay home and study.'

questions.q: Why might the district office call Hafsa?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'If a teacher is sick, the office could ask her to work as a substitute.'

questions.q: What could Emre do if the tickets are sold out?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'he could stay home and cook dinner with his mom.'

questions.q: When will they decide on their plans?

script.text: Good idea. Or we could visit the museum if it rains. That is another option.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Great. Text me tonight and we will decide.

writing.promptTr: Hafta sonu için kesin olmayan planlarını yaz. might, may ve could kullan; neye bağlı olduğunu da belirt (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write about your uncertain plans for the weekend. Use might, may and could.
writing.model: This weekend my plans are not sure. On Saturday, I might go to the farmers market with Linda, or I may stay home and study English. It depends on the weather. If it rains, we could visit the museum instead. On Sunday, Emre might cook dinner, but he may be busy with his friends. The district could also call me for a sub job on Friday. If that happens, I might be too tired to go out. Perhaps I will decide on Friday evening.
checklistTr: Might / may / could'tan sonra yalın fiil var mı (might goes değil)?

'It depends on' ile bir şart belirttin mi?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
